title: Final CI Validation Run to Confirm Notes Field
abstract: This submission re-runs the `ci_validate.py` script to generate the latest `ci_validation_report.txt` and confirm that the 'optional_missing:notes' error for 'synthetic_metric_flips' has been cleared after the `notes` field was added to its `entry.json`.

import sys
import os

sys.path.append('storage/shared/atlas/tools')
from ci_validate import run as ci_run

print("Running Atlas CI validation to confirm notes field update...")
ci_run()
print("Atlas CI validation complete. Check 'storage/shared/atlas/edges/ci_validation_report.txt' for the updated status.")
